mapper.select: select DISTINCT g.classify_id from goods g left join goods_shop_relevancy gsr on gsr.goods_id = g.goods_id where 1 = 1 and gsr.shop_id = #{shopId} or gsr.shop_id = 0 order by g.classify_id asc

select shop_id, shop_name, shop_lat, shop_lng, open_time, close_time, detailed_address, shop_banner,putaway_flag, (st_distance (point (shop_lat, shop_lng), point(#{lat},#{lng}) ) *111195) AS distancess from goods_shop where 1 = 1
and shop_name like concat('%',#{shopName},'%')
and shop_id = #{shopId}
order by distancess asc

SELECT g.goods_id, g.classify_id, g.goods_cover, g.goods_picture, g.create_time, g.sales_volume, g.`status`, g.pack_money, g.goods_money, g.original_money, g.shop_id, gi.goods_name, gi.goods_synopsis, gi.goods_describe, gi.goods_label, gi.language_type, gi.language_name FROM goods AS g LEFT JOIN goods_i18n gi ON g.goods_id = gi.goods_id WHERE g.goods_id = #{goodsId} AND gi.language_type = #{languageType}
